exposure: continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) initiation within 1 year of Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) diagnosis
insulin delivery methods (multiple daily injection (MDI) vs. continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII))
outcome: diabetes-related emergency visits (severe hypoglycemia or hyperglycemia)
cohort: The study included 396 newly diagnosed patients with T1D (94% children <18 years, 5% adults, 46% females) diagnosed between January 2013 and December 2015 at Barbara Davis Center for Diabetes.
finding: Early initiation of CGM within 1 year from T1D diagnosis, irrespective of insulin delivery system, was associated with significantly better glucose control (lower A1c) and fewer diabetes-related emergency visits.
